key_points: CEO George Kurian sold 37,000 shares (approximately $7.4M) under a trading plan, confirmed by multiple sources including MarketBeat and GuruFocus
Additional insider selling reported totaling $7.4 million in common stock
Multiple independent outlets (Yahoo Finance Australia, Moomoo, stocktitan.net) corroborate the insider selling activity
Large-scale executive share sales typically signal concerns about near-term performance and can weigh down stock prices
Despite AI-driven positive coverage, the combined weight of insider selling actions creates a net bearish bias in the short term
